name: Account Research Specialist
tagline: Scores each account's fit and warmth, builds a research pack you can share
description: Combines Salesforce records with live external signals to gauge how well each account fits and how warm it runs, then assembles a research pack per account that you can share around. Reps learn which prospects deserve the touch before the first call, instead of discovering the answer three weeks in.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
